project_core_alphabet.meaning: Existing three core alphabet name tables, not a new multilingual validation claim

symbol_names.⋭: does not contain as normal subgroup equal
symbol_names.▧: square upper left lower right fill
symbol_names.▨: square upper right lower left fill
symbol_names.◕: circle all but upper left quadrant filled
symbol_names.◷: hollow circle with upper right quadrant
symbol_names.🫢: face with open eyes and hand over mouth
symbol_names.🫰: hand with index finger and thumb crossed
symbol_names.⊈: neither a subset of nor equal to
symbol_names.⊉: neither a superset of nor equal to
symbol_names.≆: approximately but not actually equal to

aliases: approximately but not actually equal to
bank_entries.text: approximately but not actually equal to

aliases: neither a subset of nor equal to
bank_entries.text: neither a subset of nor equal to

aliases: neither a superset of nor equal to
bank_entries.text: neither a superset of nor equal to

semantics.symbol_names: Upstream explicit native-locale symbol replacements, requiring acoustic/frontend validation
semantics.phonetic_descriptions: Spelling examples only; never promoted to ordinary alphabet names
semantics.exemplar_units: Glyph repertoire only; never assumed to be spoken names
semantics.symbol_keys: Pinned explicit CLDR/NVDA native names; supplementary symbols and bounded emoji sequences stay symbol_names, never ordinary alphabet names
semantics.bank_storage_kind: The letters bank stores short navigation clips for both symbols and letters; source_kind distinguishes their linguistic semantics

symbol_bank_preparation.scope: Full native symbol_names remain available at runtime. This is a bounded preparation plan, not existing PCM. The voice bank builder must also enforce its global index byte limit across selected languages.
